programme.title: Teens (aka She's Too Young)

programme.title: Close Up
programme.desc: Exploring the lives and careers of the well-known and famous from the worlds of music and film, these 26-minute long biographical portraits provide a pictorial insight into the background, careers and personal lives of some of the twentieth-century's best known personalities and iconic faces.

programme.title: Zoom In
programme.desc: Zoom In is a TV series that helps us to peep into the inside of the magic process of film making. It is an exciting trip to the hottest movies production. Get the insiders' look at the budget and the crew all in just seven minutes. Top actors and actresses, writers, producers and directors share a part of their secrets about their job. See with your own eyes the action scenes from shooting and find out what it is really like to make a movie.

programme.desc: Mystery thriller about Cathy Davis (Lea Thompson, 'Back to the Future'), a housewife and mother who leads a double life as a government agent. Despite having retired from undercover work, Cathy is called back into service when the wife of a prominent lawyer is kidnapped. She soon finds herself facing one of the most baffling puzzles of her career.

programme.title: An Old Fashioned Thanksgiving
programme.desc: In the late 1880's, a widowed mother of three struggles to keep her family intact and to put food on the table. The oldest daughter sends a letter to her estranged, very wealthy grandmother urging her assistance, much to her mother's disapproval. When the grandmother arrives, old wounds are opened but eventually healed. From a story by Louisa May Alcott. Stars Jacqueline Bisset, Ted Atherton, Tatiana Maslany, Helene Joy, Paula Boudreau, and Michael Barbuto.

programme.title: The Lion in Winter
programme.desc: King Henry II meets with Eleanor of Aquitaine at Christmastide 1183 to choose one of his sons as his successor.

programme.title: The Lion in Winter

programme.title: Tin Man
programme.desc: After a storm sent by the tyrannical sorceress Azkadellia, DG manages to escape her small town and finds herself in the dangerous underworld know as the O.Z. There she befriends three of its inhabitants: Glitch, Wyatt Cain and Raw and meets the great Mystic Man. They all help her escape from the evil sorceress who's after her.

programme.title: Answered by Fire
programme.desc: Canadian RCMP officer Zoe Brennan, Australian Federal Policeman Mark Waldman and a young East Timorese translator named Ismenio Soares are brought together by the UN's fateful effort to give the Timorese a voice in their own future. In the chaotic run-up to the vote, these initially reluctant partners become real friends. But when the UN evacuates in the post-ballot rampage, Mark and Zoe are forced to abandon Ismenio and his family to a nightmarish fate. Haunted by guilt, the two westerners each find their way back to Timor, driven to make amends to the people they tried - and failed - to protect.

Alia resists possession by the baron while Irulan declines Jessica's offer to return with her to Caladan.

programme.title: Righteous Kill

Co-starring Curtis Jackson, Carla Gugino, Donnie Wahlberg, Trilby Glover, with Brian Dennehy, and John Leguizamo. Directed by Jon Avnet; written by Russell Gewirtz.

programme.title: Curling
programme.desc: Curling is an unique mix of shuffleboard and bowling on ice, with the strategy of chess thrown in for good measure, curling features two four-person teams who alternate sliding a large stone across the ice toward a bull's eye 126 feet away. Curling is not the easiest sport for the casual observer to try. Finding an ice rink, a 42-pound polished granite stone, and a set of brooms would pose a challenge for most of the people. Sportyfy helps curling enthusiasts to discover in depth this unusual ice sport by providing practical lessons and professional advises.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Kauno „Žalgiris“_ Vitorijos „Baskonia“
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: HISTORY's hit series, PAWN STARS, enters viewers inside the door of a family run pawnshop in Las Vegas, where three generations of men from the Harrison family grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey jointly run the business, with clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. This family lives and breathes the pawning business, using their sharp-eyed skills to carefully assess the value of items their colorful customers bring in, ranging from the obscure to the truly historical objects.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: ANCIENT ALIENS examines 75 million years of the most credible alien evidence here on Earth, from the age of the dinosaurs, to ancient Egypt, to the skies over the western desert in the present day US. programme.title: The Curse of Oak Island
programme.desc: For over two centuries, teams of searchers, including Franklin D. programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: In Storage Wars show a team of professional buyers will prove that for a good buy you need more than certain sum of money. When rent is not paid on a storage locker for a certain period, the contents can be sold as a single lot of items in the form of an auction. The best experts are fighting for containers' contents, hundreds of thousands of dollars are sometimes in the game. Every participant has only some minutes to inspect the contents, and that only without entering the storage room, just looking inside. Each purchase can become a win or a loss, and nobody knows exactly whether they are buying real treasures or garbage.

programme.title: Life After People
programme.desc: This unique documentary series explores what the planet would look like if all human life diappeared. With comment and opinion coming from scientists, engineers and other experts, this show speculates on how a lack of human intervention would impact on the environment and the other animal species. The show does not provide any explanation as to why humans have vanished from the face of the Earth but does surmise that human infrastructure is still present along with pets and domesticated livestock. Each episode explores what would happen to specific structures such as skyscrapers, bridges and dams or details the impact on human remains, artefacts and other objects. Some real-life abandoned locations are discussed and the show also uses CGI dramatisations to depict how the situation would look after one day, one week, one year, 10 years, 15 years, 25 years, 50 years, 100 years, 200 years, etc.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Marvels
programme.desc: With leopards in its mountains, blue whales off its coasts, and foxes roaming its city centres, Europe is a continent full of wild surprises. From the frozen glaciers of Iceland to the lush islands of the Azores, and from the rugged peaks of the Caucasus to the metropolis of London, the first episode in this stunning series highlights Europe's astonishing diversity, all shot with breath-taking brio and the latest technology to reveal the continent and its animals in all its breath-taking glory.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Marvels
programme.desc: Europe's mountains may offer incredible views, but they are rarely an easy place to live. Golden eagles must soar high over the Alps to find food, while stags in the Scottish Highlands battle it out for valuable grazing land. Kidnapping is rife among Gibraltar's Barbary macaques, and - in Norway's high plateaus - musk oxen can't escape the harsh merciless winter. Faced with rugged landscapes and extreme weather conditions, Europe's high-altitude animals must either adapt… or die trying.

programme.title: Trials of the Wild
programme.desc: Watch a range of wild animals trying to survive in the wilderness as they migrate, hunt and defend themselves against predators and the dangers that are living alongside them. Follow animals born to fight to those designed to live in the canopy of trees as the series gives you an insight into natures greatest spectacles from around the world on land, water and air. This nature documentary is intriguing and engaging as they examine a range of species and how they survive in the most brutal environments.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pols have reached the most dangerous stage of disassembling the 100-year-old barn: taking down the beams. Then, if all goes well, theyll transport the beams back to the farm. Each part of this process must be carefully orchestrated to protect these irreplaceable beams. Meanwhile, Beth tries training Clovis after he runs away from the farm.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol's rush to prepare for their farm's first Michigan winter. The family goes into hyperdrive to fix the pasture fence and finish building the garden hardscape before the first snow falls. Beth is worried about the bees, so she brings in some expert help to hopefully ensure their survival.

programme.title: Wild Transylvania: Dracula's Hidden Kingdom
programme.desc: Dracula's Transylvania lair is brimming with amazing wildlife. Shielded by the Carpathian Mountains, it's a pristine wonderland that remains unchanged since the Middle Ages. Home to 26 species of bats, his kingdom is truly a night flyer's paradise. Chamois, cuckoos, Ural owls, wild boar, lynx, brown bears, and huge wolf packs also thrive in a natural world beyond Bram Stoker's imagination.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: This show explores the unbridled natural beauty of America's national parks and highlights some of the most awe-inspiring scenery on the planet. Travelling beyond the more conventional tourist hot-spots, the viewer is transported to the hidden wonders of America's wild spaces. Episodes include joining a scientific exploration of the 277 mile long Grand Canyon, studying its geological history, exploring the microscopic colonies of vegetation and examining its unique creatures; journeying through the Everglades, a 1.5 million acre home to strange creatures, carnivorous plants, amphibious birds and fish that can breathe air; and navigating across the northwest archipelago of Hawaii following a team of diving scientists as they inspect the unique aquaeous flora and fauna.

Home to 26 species of bats, his kingdom is truly a night flyer's paradise. Chamois, cuckoos, Ural owls, wild boar, lynx, brown bears, and huge wolf packs also thrive in a natural world beyond Bram Stoker's imagination.

programme.title: Mara: Rebirth
programme.desc: Part 2 sets the scene, now the zebras wander off, a striped echo of part one. If the first episode is dusted in browns and yellows, this is green as the landscape changes and the rain turn again, rising rivers, making it difficult for everyone again, flooding, rushing waters in a raging torrent. Paradise it may be, but it is a harsh paradise. As the rains clear, we catch up with another character introduced in the first episode, our serval mother that had her den flooded; but she reveals that she has survived. And so has her cub - a miracle under these circumstances.

programme.title: Underdogs
programme.desc: Ryan Reynolds reveals some highly questionable parenting strategies from the animal kingdom's worst parents, the underdogs. From a goose who lays their eggs on the top of a cliff to a koala that feeds its baby poop, it's uncertain if they bad parents or just misunderstood. But no matter how bad one thinks they may be at parenting; they can't be as bad as these guys.

programme.title: Europe's New Wild
programme.desc: This stunning six-part nature series tells the inspiring story of the rebirthing of the wild regions of the continent of Europe. A land formerly full of diverse wildlife and contrasting landscapes, Europe was in need of special rewilding teams to embark on a mission to return species to their natural habitat and this series focuses on six regions that have benefitted from the project. The Carpathian Mountains of Romania have seen the reintroduction of European bison while rural depopulation in Spain and Portugal offers up the opportunity to expand the wild nature of the Iberian Peninsula. The teams also look at how bears and humans can live peacefully, side by side and explores the myriad creatures that call the Danube Delta home. The unique culture and atmosphere of Lapland plays host to distinctive wildlife and the Sámi people and a natural balance is being restored to the Balkans.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Reality show follows Dutch-born veterinarian Jan Pol, his family and employees' everyday. Jan Pol and his wife Diane started their own practice in Weidman, Michigan, Pol Veterinary Services, back in in 1981. Dr Pol takes a good care of every family pet and head of livestock no matter what size or condition and is a true legend in the community. Dr Pol has seen it all, treating numerous patients every single day, his daily routine is more than 12 hours but nothing can stop him from being devoted to his patients.

programme.title: Underdogs
programme.desc: Ryan Reynolds puts the spotlight on the underdogs who get ahead by dishonest means. From the master-of-disguise frogfish to a butt-biting jackal and a multiheaded caterpillar playing the decoy, they are the masters of deception and deceit. And bringing all these hustlers together is the greatest con artist of them all - a cunning macaque who feeds on the spoils from unsuspecting tourists.

programme.title: Underdogs

programme.title: Underdogs
programme.desc: Ryan shares his distinct take on the underdogs using gross-out tactics to win the game of life. With manatees using flatulence to control their buoyancy to cave-dwelling fungus gnats creating beautifully illuminated flytraps with mucus from their butts, these underdogs are out to prove who may be the grossest survivor of them all.

programme.title: Underdogs
programme.desc: Ryan Reynolds assembles "The Superzeros," a team of somewhat pitiful animals with unexpectedly awesome superpowers. Forget about the cheetah's speed and the eagle's eyesight; and say hello to the invisible glass frog, the indestructible honey badger and the might of the pistol shrimp who can fire bubbles hotter than the sun.

programme.title: The Incredible Honey Badger
programme.desc: Honey badgers live a life of fearless confrontation. From the very beginning, they go through nature's ultimate boot camp. These small, curious creatures take stings from scorpions and endure swarms of angry bees—all lessons that strengthen them against far more lethal threats. Over time, they develop an almost supernatural resilience to venom and pain. Honey badgers take on predators many times their size, from lions to leopards. To survive, these resilient animals rely on sharp senses, loose skin, and an unbreakable fighting spirit. Through astonishing footage of real-life confrontations, we see how each brush with death refines the honey badger's fearlessness. Their myth becomes reality as we watch one of nature's toughest living legends and discover what truly makes them so invincible.

programme.title: Born in Africa
programme.desc: Born in Africa is a documentary following the stories of newborns in five animal families in the African savanna, from their first steps to the moment they become independent. These little lions, cheetahs, hyenas, meerkats and jackals must face many challenges along the way, as their mothers do everything to protect them in these most vulnerable stages of life. Watch them as they grow and learn how to move and get by in the wilderness in this intimate portrayal of family dynamics in the natural world.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pols have reached the most dangerous stage of disassembling the 100-year-old barn: taking down the beams. Then, if all goes well, theyll transport the beams back to the farm. Each part of this process must be carefully orchestrated to protect these irreplaceable beams. Meanwhile, Beth tries training Clovis after he runs away from the farm.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol's rush to prepare for their farm's first Michigan winter. The family goes into hyperdrive to fix the pasture fence and finish building the garden hardscape before the first snow falls. Beth is worried about the bees, so she brings in some expert help to hopefully ensure their survival.

programme.title: Trials of the Wild
programme.desc: Watch a range of wild animals trying to survive in the wilderness as they migrate, hunt and defend themselves against predators and the dangers that are living alongside them. Follow animals born to fight to those designed to live in the canopy of trees as the series gives you an insight into natures greatest spectacles from around the world on land, water and air. This nature documentary is intriguing and engaging as they examine a range of species and how they survive in the most brutal environments.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: She haunts the trees and hills in the heart of the realm. She is solitary, silent and virtually invisible. Saba the leopard is a killer without rival. Saba is the most spectacular and resourceful hunter the Savage Kingdom has seen. Her stronghold, Leopard Rock, sits at the heart of this brutal realm it is a place where she can vanish into the shadows and avoid running into her rivals lions, hyenas and wild dogs. There is no question that Saba the leopard can take care of herself, but her strength and resilience will be cruelly tested when she tries to bring two cubs into the realm where only she can protect and feed them in the midst of the cauldron of warring predators. The ordeal will tear at her heart.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: Brand new series. Savute, Botswana: 2000 square miles of remote African savannah. This ancient land is governed by competing clans of ruthlessly proficient predators - leopards, lions, hyenas and wild dogs. Their survival depends on the giant herds of powerful prey - buffalo, elephant and zebra - who have roamed Savute in search of sustenance, season after season, millennium after millennium. Each day is a life-or-death struggle - animal against animal, animal against nature. There is no mercy, and there is but one rule: survive. In this episode, a small family of wild dogs goes on the run, desperately looking for a safe place to raise six tiny puppies. But the Savage Kingdom will test them to the limit. Narrated by Charles Dance.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: The series Bubble Guppies revolves around the underwater adventures of a group of mermaid-like preschoolers who life in the fictional underwater city of Bubbletucky. The episode starts with a sketch of Molly saying "Hi, it's me Molly and it's time for-" only to be stopped by Gil doing the subject of the show. programme.title: Football: LaLiga
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. programme.desc: Il ritmo serrato del thriller per ripercorrere uno storico evento mediatico. 1972: durante le Olimpiadi di Monaco di Baviera, un commando palestinese uccide due atleti israeliani e ne prende in ostaggio nove. Una troupe della ABC documenta i drammatici eventi in tempo reale.

programme.title: The Brutalist

programme.title: Shining
programme.desc: Jack Nicholson nel capolavoro di Kubrick tratto da Stephen King. Dopo aver accettato l'impiego di custode, uno scrittore si trasferisce con la famiglia in un remoto hotel di montagna.

programme.title: Joker: Folie à Deux
programme.desc: Joaquin Phoenix riveste i panni del folle personaggio della DC Comics in uno sbalorditivo sequel con Lady Gaga. Internato nel manicomio di Arkham in attesa del processo per i crimini commessi, Arthur Fleck si innamora di Lee Quinzel, una paziente affascinata dalla figura del Joker.

programme.title: Il colosso di Rodi
programme.desc: Lo spettacolare esordio alla regia di Sergio Leone. Sull'isola greca un gruppo di congiurati si ribella contro il Re Serse, mentre i Fenici stanno per attaccare la citta'.

programme.title: Un eroe
programme.desc: Grand Prix della Giuria a Cannes per il pluripremiato Asghar Farhadi. Un detenuto rinuncia a una borsa piena d'oro restituendola al proprietario. Diventera' un eroe ma con esiti imprevisti.

programme.title: September 5 - La diretta che cambiò la storia
programme.desc: Il ritmo serrato del thriller per ripercorrere uno storico evento mediatico. 1972: durante le Olimpiadi di Monaco di Baviera, un commando palestinese uccide due atleti israeliani e ne prende in ostaggio nove. Una troupe della ABC documenta i drammatici eventi in tempo reale.

programme.title: Fuga da Alcatraz
programme.desc: Cult assoluto del cinema carcerario diretto da Don Siegel. Clint Eastwood è un detenuto in fuga dall'inespugnabile penitenziario di Alcatraz, amministrato da un sadico aguzzino.

programme.title: L'ora più buia
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Gary Oldman nel film che racconta i primi turbolenti giorni da Primo Ministro di Winston Churchill. Nel 1940, il celebre statista inglese deve affrontare l'avanzata dei nazisti e prendere decisioni drammatiche per il bene del suo paese, ma deve fare i conti con lo scettico re e con alcuni membri del suo partito che sembrano tramare contro di lui. Oscar anche al trucco. La pellicola è stato candidata anche per la sceneggiatura, scritta da Anthony McCarten che aveva firmato anche un altro fortunato biopic, “La teoria del tutto”.

programme.title: Questo o quello: Woody Allen
programme.desc: Gli esperti di Sky Cinema, Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova, analizzano e mettono a confronto due film in programmazione sui canali Sky a puntata, per un confronto ricco di approfondimenti.

programme.title: Magic in The Moonlight

programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Cate Blanchett in una pellicola di Woody Allen. Una donna in crisi lascia New York e si trasferisce a San Francisco per rimettere ordine nella sua vita.

programme.desc: Oscar ai costumi per la pellicola di Paul Thomas Anderson con un formidabile Daniel Day-Lewis. Londra, anni 50: la vita di un rinomato stilista viene turbata dall'infatuazione per una donna.

programme.desc: Jack Nicholson nel capolavoro di Kubrick tratto da Stephen King. Dopo aver accettato l'impiego di custode, uno scrittore si trasferisce con la famiglia in un remoto hotel di montagna.

programme.desc: Clint Eastwood affronta la piaga del terrorismo dirigendo un dramma tratto da una storia vera, interpretata dagli eroi che l'hanno realmente vissuta. Spencer Stone, Alek Skarlatos e Anthony Sadler sono tre ragazzi di Sacramento, amici di lunga data, che stanno passando le vacanze in giro per l'Europa. E il 21 agosto del 2015 si trovano a bordo del treno Thalys 9364 diretto da Amsterdam a Parigi. Il treno, con a bordo circa 500 passeggeri, è anche l'obiettivo dell'Isis, ma saranno proprio Spencer, Alek e Anthony a sventare l'attentato, trasformandosi da persone comuni a eroi.

programme.title: La guerra dei mondi
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg dirige Tom Cruise nello spettacolare remake di un grande classico della fantascienza. Un operaio difende la famiglia da un'invasione aliena.

Giunti su un'isola verranno pero' attaccati da una nave americana rischiando di essere schiavizzati ancora. Seconda nomination agli Oscar per Anthony Hopkins nel ruolo di un Presidente degli Stati Uniti (qui interpreta John Q. Adams) dopo quella ottenuta per "Nixon".

programme.title: Salvate il soldato Ryan
programme.desc: 5 Oscar per il film di guerra firmato Steven Spielberg, con Tom Hanks e Matt Damon. Dopo lo sbarco in Normandia, un plotone va in cerca dell'unico soldato superstite di quattro fratelli.

programme.desc: Michelle Williams e Paul Dano nel film piu' intimo e autobiografico di Steven Spielberg. Quando l'armonia della sua famiglia si incrina, Sammy si rifugia nella settima arte.

programme.title: Schindler's List - La lista di Schindler
programme.desc: 7 Oscar al kolossal di Steven Spielberg con Liam Neeson e Ben Kingsley. La vera storia del tedesco Oskar Schindler che salvò centinaia di ebrei dalla Shoah, impiegandoli nella sua fabbrica.

programme.desc: Golden Globe a Whoopi Goldberg nello spettacolare affresco storico di Steven Spielberg. America, anni 20: la storia di una ragazza di colore violentata e trattata come una schiava.

programme.title: La guerra dei mondi
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg dirige Tom Cruise nello spettacolare remake di un grande classico della fantascienza. Un operaio difende la famiglia da un'invasione aliena.

programme.desc: Steven Spielberg dirige Meryl Streep e Tom Hanks in un capolavoro sulla libertà di stampa. 1971: il Washington Post entra in possesso di documenti del Pentagono sulla guerra in Vietnam.

programme.desc: 7 Oscar al kolossal di Steven Spielberg con Liam Neeson e Ben Kingsley. La vera storia del tedesco Oskar Schindler che salvò centinaia di ebrei dalla Shoah, impiegandoli nella sua fabbrica.

programme.desc: Il grande ritorno di Harrison Ford nel quarto capitolo con Cate Blanchett e Shia LaBeouf. Pedinato dai sovietici Indy deve ritrovare una reliquia dai poteri soprannaturali.

programme.desc: 3 Oscar e 1 Golden Globe allo spettacolare blockbuster di Steven Spielberg con Roy Scheider, Robert Shaw e Richard Dreyfuss. Un feroce squalo semina il terrore in un’isola dell’Atlantico.

programme.desc: Steven Spielberg adatta il romanzo di fantascienza di Ernest Cline. Anno 2045: un giovane entra in un videogioco per sfidare gli altri partecipanti a una caccia al tesoro virtuale.

programme.desc: John Landis dirige Eddie Murphy e Dan Aykroyd nella piu' classica delle commedie natalizie. Per una scommessa, due perfidi finanzieri sostituiscono un loro dirigente con un senzatetto.

programme.title: 10 giorni con Babbo Natale
programme.desc: Alessandro Genovesi dirige una commedia natalizia 'on the road' con Fabio De Luigi, Diego Abantantuono e Valentina Lodovini, premiata con il Nastro d'Argento. In camper verso Stoccolma, la famiglia Rovelli investe un uomo che è convinto di essere Babbo Natale.

programme.title: La vigilia di Natale nel Paese delle Meraviglie

programme.title: Una famiglia per Natale
programme.desc: Il destino di un albergo e lo sviluppo delle relazioni di una donna subiranno una svolta proprio durante il periodo delle vacanze natalizie.

I due, amici di lunga data, finiscono a letto insieme e decidono di instaurare una relazione puramente fisica, senza alcun coinvolgimento: ci si diverte ma i sentimenti devono esser tenuti ben lontani. Jocelyn dovra' fare i conti con un aspetto da lui sempre trascurato, il sentimento, quello che inizia a provare per Florence. Theresa Osbourne è una giornalista che ha trovato un messaggio in una bottiglia sulla spiaggia, firmato "G". Colpita dalle parole appassionate del testo, si mette sulle tracce di quell'uomo misterioso che affida al mare i suoi messaggi d'amore. Il loro destino si intreccia con quello di Matilde e Teresa, in cerca di un'occasione perche' anche la merceria dove lavorano accusa le difficolta' economiche. Mimi', pero', e' arrivata in citta' anche per un altro motivo: e' infatti la figlia del proprietario della fabbrica e deve vendere le proprieta' di famiglia.

Per caso, in un bar, sente parlare di una donna, Maggie Carpenter, che piu' di una volta ha abbandonato sull'altare i suoi fidanzati. Ike le dedica il suo prossimo articolo, finendo per scatenare l'ira della donna che ne ottiene il licenziamento. Ma Ike non si da' per vinto e decide di fare un viaggio fino nel Maryland per scoprire la verita'.

programme.desc: Celebre commedia diretta da Carlo Vanzina con Jerry Calà e Christian De Sica. Estate 1964: sulle spiagge della Versilia si intrecciano le vicende di un gruppo di vacanzieri in cerca di avventure, in particolare quelle di Paolo e Marina, due fratelli napoletani, e di Luca e Felicino, fratelli milanesi ricchi e viziati. Amori e avventure in un periodo per molti indimenticabile. Sullo sfondo i successi musicali dei meravigliosi anni 60. David di Donatello e Nastro d’argento come miglior attrice non protagonista a Virna Lisi.

programme.title: Senza arte ne' parte
programme.desc: Vincenzo Salemme e Giuseppe Battiston in una commedia sull'arte di arrangiarsi. Rimasti disoccupati, tre operai accettano di fare da custodi a una collezione di opere d'arte...

programme.title: La casa di famiglia
programme.desc: Stefano Fresi, Matilde Gioli, Libero De Rienzo e Lino Guanciale in una commedia degli equivoci. Venduta la tenuta di famiglia, 4 fratelli devono ripensarci quando il padre esce dal coma.

programme.title: Gli idoli delle donne
programme.desc: Nella commedia con Lillo e Greg e Corrado Guzzanti, il gigolo' piu' avvenente in circolazione, trasfigurato da un incidente, dovra' imparare da un guru nuove tecniche di seduzione.

programme.title: Brave ragazze
programme.desc: Ambra Angiolini, Serena Rossi, Ilenia Pastorelli e Silvia D’Amico nella commedia diretta da Michela Andreozzi. Quattro ragazze di Gaeta si travestono da uomini per rapinare una banca.

programme.title: Ritorno al crimine
programme.desc: Massimiliano Bruno dirige un grande cast nel sequel targato Sky Original. I 4 amici si ritrovano a Montecarlo sulle tracce della ragazza che aveva rapito il cuore di uno e i soldi di tutti.

programme.title: C'era una volta il crimine
programme.desc: Terzo capitolo della saga di Massimiliano Bruno, con Marco Giallini, Gianmarco Tognazzi, Giampaolo Morelli ed Edoardo Leo. La banda viaggia fino al 1943 per rubare la Gioconda ai francesi.

programme.title: Tutti per 1 - 1 per tutti
programme.desc: Tornano i moschettieri Pierfrancesco Favino, Valerio Mastandrea, Rocco Papaleo, assieme alla regina Margherita Buy, diretti da Giovanni Veronesi nel primo film targato Sky Original.

programme.title: Se Dio vuole
programme.desc: Marco Giallini e Alessandro Gassmann nella commedia d'esordio di Edoardo Falcone. Un cardiochirurgo ateo entra in crisi quando il figlio annuncia di voler diventare sacerdote.

programme.title: C'era una truffa a Hollywood
programme.desc: Commedia Sky Original con i premi Oscar Robert De Niro, Morgan Freeman e Tommy Lee Jones. Per sanare un debito con la malavita, due produttori cinematografici organizzano una truffa.

programme.title: Con chi viaggi
programme.desc: Gli YouNuts! dirigono una comedy on the road con Fabio Rovazzi, Lillo, Alessandra Mastronardi e Michela De Rossi. Una app di Car-Sharing riunisce 4 sconosciuti in un viaggio avventuroso.

programme.title: Questione di karma
programme.desc: Fabio De Luigi ed Elio Germano animano un'ironica commedia esoterica. Il facoltoso Giacomo viene convinto da un guru che suo padre si è reincarnato in Mario, un imbroglione pieno di debiti.

programme.title: Beata ignoranza
programme.desc: Alessandro Gassmann e Marco Giallini in una commedia di Massimiliano Bruno. Due insegnanti di liceo, divisi dall'amore per la stessa donna, si scontrano sull'utilità dei social network.

programme.title: 2 gran figli di...
programme.desc: Owen Wilson, Ed Helms ("Una notte da leoni") e Glenn Close in una commedia 'on the road'. Peter e Kyle Reynolds sono due fratelli gemelli che si trovano, ormai adulti, davanti a una sconcertante verità: il loro padre biologico non è affatto morto ma nessuno, nemmeno la loro mamma Helen, ne conosce l'identità. Decidono quindi di attraversare gli Stati Uniti con la speranza di rintracciare l'uomo. Ma per farlo dovranno ascoltare tutte le avventure sessuali vissute dalla focosa e libertina Helen nei disinibiti anni Settanta. Nel cast i premi Oscar J.K. Simmons e Christopher Walken.

programme.title: Maschi contro femmine
programme.desc: Paola Cortellesi, Fabio De Luigi e Alessandro Preziosi nella commedia sbanca-botteghino di Fausto Brizzi che intreccia storie di crisi sentimentali, tradimenti e ricerca della felicità.

programme.title: Brave ragazze
programme.desc: Ambra Angiolini, Serena Rossi, Ilenia Pastorelli e Silvia D’Amico nella commedia diretta da Michela Andreozzi. Quattro ragazze di Gaeta si travestono da uomini per rapinare una banca.

programme.title: Truffatori in erba
programme.desc: Action-comedy con Charlize Theron, David Oyelowo, Joel Edgerton e Amanda Seyfried. Il manager di una compagnia farmaceutica finge di essere rapito per ottenere i soldi del riscatto.

programme.title: Sconnessi
programme.desc: Commedia corale con Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Ricky Memphis, Carolina Crescentini e Stefano Fresi. I componenti di una famiglia entrano in crisi quando si ritrovano in una baita senza internet.

programme.title: Se Dio vuole
programme.desc: Marco Giallini e Alessandro Gassmann nella commedia d'esordio di Edoardo Falcone. Un cardiochirurgo ateo entra in crisi quando il figlio annuncia di voler diventare sacerdote.

programme.title: Mollami
programme.desc: Road movie targato Sky Original diretto da Matteo Gentiloni. Un’adolescente problematica viene costretta dal padre ad andare in collegio, ma il viaggio non sarà semplice.

programme.title: Questione di karma
programme.desc: Fabio De Luigi ed Elio Germano animano un'ironica commedia esoterica. Il facoltoso Giacomo viene convinto da un guru che suo padre si è reincarnato in Mario, un imbroglione pieno di debiti.

programme.title: Un matrimonio da favola
programme.desc: Commedia di Carlo Vanzina con Adriano Giannini e Ricky Memphis. Un gruppo di amici del liceo si ritrova dopo 20 anni in occasione di un matrimonio. Faranno un bilancio delle loro vite.

programme.title: La rivincita delle sfigate
programme.desc: Esordio alla regia di Olivia Wilde con una commedia sulla trasgressione. Per recuperare il tempo passato a studiare, due studentesse decidono di trascorrere una lunga notte di eccessi.

programme.title: Scemo e più scemo
programme.desc: Jim Carrey e Jeff Daniels nel celebre road movie demenziale firmato dai fratelli Farrelly. Due amici svitati ne combinano di tutti i colori per restituire una valigetta a una donna.

programme.title: Il campione
programme.desc: Emozionante pellicola di Leonardo D'Agostini con Stefano Accorsi e Andrea Carpenzano. Per disciplinare un giovane fuoriclasse, il presidente gli affianca un insegnante privato.

programme.title: Hazzard
programme.desc: Jessica Simpson, Burt Reynolds e Johnny Knoxville nella commedia ispirata alla serie cult degli anni 80. I cugini Bo e Luke Duke cercano di contrastare i piani criminali di Boss Hogg.

programme.title: Le amiche della sposa
programme.desc: Commedia di successo di Paul Feig con Kristen Wiig e Melissa McCarthy. Annie, damigella d'onore alle nozze della migliore amica Lilian, deve arginare le mosse astute delle altre ragazze.

programme.title: Un matrimonio da favola
programme.desc: Commedia di Carlo Vanzina con Adriano Giannini e Ricky Memphis. Un gruppo di amici del liceo si ritrova dopo 20 anni in occasione di un matrimonio. Faranno un bilancio delle loro vite.

programme.title: Ricchi di fantasia
programme.desc: Sergio Castellitto e Sabrina Ferilli in una commedia di Francesco Micciche'. Due amanti non possono lasciare i rispettivi compagni per motivi economici. Una vincita milionaria cambia tutto.

programme.title: Thelma
programme.desc: Una fantastica June Squibb è la trascinatrice di una action-comedy carica di humor. Los Angeles: vittima di una truffa telefonica, l'ostinata e orgogliosa novantatreenne Thelma si arma di coraggio e si avventura alla ricerca del delinquente che le ha estorto il denaro.

programme.title: Il tuttofare
programme.desc: Sergio Castellitto è il principe del foro nella commedia di Valerio Attanasio. Un giovane praticante in legge sogna un contratto in un prestigioso studio ma finirà in un mare di guai.

programme.title: Compromessi sposi
programme.desc: Diego Abatantuono e Vincenzo Salemme in una commedia di Francesco Micciche'. Un imprenditore del Nord e un sindaco del Sud si alleano per impedire le nozze dei rispettivi figli.

programme.title: Il colpo del cane
programme.desc: Edoardo Pesce e Silvia D'Amico nell'ardita commedia di Fulvio Risuleo. Due giovani dogsitter subiscono il furto di un bulldog da parte di un eccentrico veterinario: il dottor Mopsi.

programme.title: Nati stanchi
programme.desc: Prima commedia da protagonisti per Ficarra e Picone. Due giovani siciliani disoccupati e svogliati partecipano ai concorsi e si presentano ai colloqui facendo in modo di non essere assunti.

programme.title: Cetto c'e', senzadubbiamente
programme.desc: Terzo capitolo di successo per il carismatico personaggio di Antonio Albanese. La vita di Cetto in Germania e' scossa dalla rivelazione della zia morente: e' l'erede naturale di un principe.

programme.title: Hazzard
programme.desc: Jessica Simpson, Burt Reynolds e Johnny Knoxville nella commedia ispirata alla serie cult degli anni 80. I cugini Bo e Luke Duke cercano di contrastare i piani criminali di Boss Hogg.

programme.title: CHiPS
programme.desc: Dax Shepard, Michael Pena e un cameo di Erik Estrada nella commedia ispirata alla serie tv anni 80. Per indagare su un giro di corruzione, un agente Fbi lavorerà con una recluta.

programme.title: E noi come st***zi rimanemmo a guardare
programme.desc: Commedia Sky Original di e con Pif, Fabio De Luigi e Ilenia Pastorelli. Licenziato a causa di un algoritmo, Arturo trova lavoro come rider e si consola con Stella, ologramma nato da una app.

programme.title: Una terapia di gruppo
programme.desc: Commedia corale con Claudio Bisio diretta da Paolo Costella. Per errore, sei pazienti ricevono appuntamento dallo psicologo alla stessa ora con esiti inaspettati.

programme.title: La stanza degli omicidi
programme.desc: Due criminali organizzano un sistema di riciclaggio di denaro sporco con una gallerista d'arte di New York. Il sistema sembra funzionare a gonfie vele, finche' un imprevisto non complica la faccenda.

programme.title: Febbre da cavallo - La mandrakata
programme.desc: Carlo Vanzina dirige Gigi Proietti ed Enrico Montesano nel sequel del cult degli anni 70. Ancora accanito scommettitore, Mandrake coinvolge un gruppo di buffi complici in una truffa.

programme.title: Mr Cobbler e la bottega magica
programme.desc: Adam Sandler vive mille avventure in una commedia fantastica dal regista premio Oscar per "Il caso Spotlight". Max Simkin e' un solitario calzolaio newyorkese che conduce una vita grigia e monotona. Almeno fino a quando, nella sua bottega, non scopre una vecchia risuolatrice: un vero e proprio cimelio, che gli permette di trasformarsi in ognuno dei suoi clienti semplicemente indossando le loro scarpe. Max ne approfittera' per dare un lustro piu' elettrizzante e avventuroso alla sua esistenza, assumendo varie identita' e andando incontro a momenti divertenti e imprevisti imbarazzanti.

programme.title: Inside Africa: ?Inside Africa's 25th Anniversary: Lupita \u0026 Angelique at the Met
programme.desc: As part of?Inside Africa's?25th anniversary, we have a sit-down between two of the continent's most celebrated voices: Angelique Kidjo?and Lupita Nyong'o. The setting is The Met's newly reimagined?Arts of Africa?gallery, a powerful space in which to reflect on African creativity, identity, and legacy. Five-time Grammy award winning Kidjo and Oscar-winning actor Nyong'o reflect on their careers and the rise and influence of African culture across the world.

programme.title: African Voices Changemakers: African Voices Changemakers LAVCM216
programme.desc: African Voices starts a new chapter as we focus on some of the Changemakers who are coming up with innovative ways to have a positive impact on their communities.

programme.title: Walk of Art: Walk of Art: Doha's Cultural Landscape
programme.desc: We explore how art has influenced the cultural landscape of Qatar and how it can be an immersive experience for those who visit, live and work there. We meet designers and artists who reflect the country's layers of creativity, cultural diversity and modern identity. They guide us through Doha's open-air gallery, taking us to the public artwork that inspires them the most and represents a milestone in Qatar's artistic evolution. From Doha Mountains and Cesar's Pouce to remembering Qatar's pearl diving heritage and the first artistic landmark - the Museum of Islamic Art.

programme.title: Global Perspectives: Global Perspectives: On Africa
programme.desc: Hosted by Zain Asher, this special half-hour program showcases the best of CNN's inaugural \"Global Perspectives: On Africa\" event, featuring interviews and session highlights with high profile political and business leaders, innovators and thought-leaders.

programme.title: \t Abominable and The Invisible City

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse

programme.title: CSI S4 E06 - Jackpot
programme.desc: Season 4 begins with terrific back-to-back episodes involving serial killers (\"Assume Nothing\" / \"For All Our Country\"). There's a new politically minded sheriff in town and in \"Invisible Evidence\" he's ticked off that the CSI's can't get enough evidence to convict a rapist/murderer. Also, Nick and Sara buck for the same promotion. Along the way there are plenty of quirky cases: one involving a museum robbery (\"Suckers\") and one involving a dead juror (\"Eleven Angry Jurors\"). Grissom travels to a small town with plenty of secrets to solve a murder in \"Jackpot,\" Catherine dates a younger man in \"Early Rollout,\" and Sara works a case involving a woman strikingly similar to herself in \"Butterflied.\" There's also plenty of kinkiness in \"Fur and Loathing\" and tragedy \"Bad Words.\".

programme.title: Iron Squad W
programme.desc: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Extreme Ends
programme.desc: Extreme Ends is an action-adventure reality show featuring four celebrities and their special guests experiencing the diversity of Hong Kong! Join award-winning Malaysian actress Siti Saleha and her husband as they explore the city by day and venture into the night, discovering its vibrant culture and hidden treasures.

programme.title: Iron Ball
programme.desc: This sports entertainment show brings the best special forces from Iron Squad to take on a new challenge – dodgeball. The 26 players will enter a fierce competition, until a strongest team armed with powerful athletic endurance and mental strength is formed. Witness how they compete in front of the star athletes and legendary dodgeball coaches!

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: 10 Fight 10 Season 3
programme.desc: The show brings Thai superstars, singers, boxers, models and rappers into the celebrity boxing ring. Season 2 features a first ever Thai female match and Season 3 has two Olympics gold medalists competing for the championship. This unique boxing show offers all-round entertainment, with live performances, lavish costumes and real fights with blood!

programme.title: Iron Squad W
programme.desc: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team’s downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: Extreme Ends
programme.desc: Extreme Ends is an action-adventure reality show featuring four celebrities and their special guests experiencing the diversity of Hong Kong! Join Filipino actor, model and swimmer Enchong Dee and his celebrity friend Ria, to explore the highs and lows of Hong Kong. They are eager to push their boundaries in this thrilling new adventure.

programme.title: Iron Ball
programme.desc: This sports entertainment show brings the best special forces from Iron Squad to take on a new challenge – dodgeball. The 26 players will enter a fierce competition, until a strongest team armed with powerful athletic endurance and mental strength is formed. Witness how they compete in front of the star athletes and legendary dodgeball coaches!

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

programme.title: Totoy Bato ep 148
programme.desc: Totoy Bato explores the origins, the pathos of the character Totoy. All the different battle he went through (terrorist, revenge for his wife, corruption, prejudice and for love) defines him as a character.

programme.title: Totoy Bato ep 149
programme.desc: Totoy Bato explores the origins, the pathos of the character Totoy. All the different battle he went through (terrorist, revenge for his wife, corruption, prejudice and for love) defines him as a character.

programme.title: Sari Saring Sine: Hindi Pa Tapos ang Laban
programme.desc: Fernando Poe Jr. stars as Carding Villamar, a city professional who returns to their hometown of Evangelista after learning of his brother's untimely demise. As a series of events unfold, he soon discovers that his brother didn't succumb to a heart attack as he was made to believe. He was shot in cold blood for refusing to sell his land to a powerful congressman. With a town muted and crippled by fear, the congressman's henchmen move unhampered to silence Carding and his brother's orphaned family as well. Big mistake. Armed with only a crusty riffle and a whole ton of rage. Carding sets out to right the wrong and exact vengeance for the murder of his brother. That is, if he survives the hot pursuits of bounty hunters, the militia and the police who are all in the congressman's payroll.

programme.title: Kurdapya ep 10
programme.desc: Kurdapya tells the story of long-lost twins, KURING \u0026 DAPHNE. They meet after a strange accident and discover that they lead extremely different lives. Kuring grew up with the cruel extended family in the province while Daphne is an undervalued publishing executive in the city. Both women want to get out of their current realities, so they decide to switch lives by pretending to be each other.

programme.title: For the Love ep 8
programme.desc: An episodic TV series touching on various kinds of love stories based on modern hits and classics from Viva Records.

programme.title: Da Pers Family ep 28
programme.desc:
A story of a couple who preserves the family 
bakery business legacy from closure. Now the 
couple’s children, volunteers to step in and help the 
business. Are the parents willing to accept change 
and innovations of the new generation?

programme.desc: Rigsby and Van Pelt go undercover as a couple with relationship problems to investigate the death of a woman who received advice from a radio love doctor.

programme.title: The Mentalist S5 22
programme.desc: Just as Jane narrows down the Red John list to seven suspects, Red John strikes again -- and the victim is linked to Jane's past, in the fifth season cliffhanger finale.

programme.title: Superman Returns

programme.title: Run All Night
programme.desc: Lately, it seems Jimmy's only solace can be found at the bottom of a whiskey glass. But when Jimmy's estranged son, Mike (The Killing's Joel Kinnaman), becomes a target, Jimmy must make a choice between the crime family he chose and the real family he abandoned long ago. With Mike on the run, Jimmy's only penance for his past mistakes may be to keep his son from the same fate Jimmy is certain he'll face himself...at the wrong end of a gun. Now, with nowhere safe to turn, Jimmy just has one night to figure out exactly where his loyalties lie and to see if he can finally make things right.

programme.title: Gangster Squad

programme.title: Friends S6 25

programme.title: GRAND BLUE
programme.desc: When Iori Kitahara heads off to college, he decides to live at his uncle's dive shop in Izu named Grand Blue. Iori is looking forward to experiencing college life amidst the roar of the waves, the blazing sun, and his cute cousin who lives with him! However, Iori runs into a group of tough guys playing strip rock-paper-scissors, and ends up joining Peek-a-Boo, the college's diving club!

programme.title: GRAND BLUE
programme.desc: After a cutthroat battle with Kohei Imamura, a handsome otaku from school, Iori ends up joining the Peek-a-Boo diving club. Iori arrives home worn out from the day, but perks up when he hears about a party with a women's college. However, his cousin Nanaka won't allow him to stay out three nights in a row, so Iori tries to show her he's an independent man to get her to let him go.
